detector._note: Keypoints 23-11-13 / 24-12-14 (hip-shoulder-elbow), 3D world angle. Rest is 10-20 (TOP at <=20), the top of the raise is 90 or more (BOTTOM at >=90); wrist only feeds the straight-elbow alignment score.

stage._note: fitmon front raise (Python backend): same wrist-over-shoulder rule as the lateral raise. Ceiling 0.15: Fifteen centimetres above the shoulder is no longer a front raise, it is the start of a press. The rep still lands the moment it crosses the counting line; the ceiling only refuses a reading the joint cannot actually produce, which is the only sense a ceiling can have when the rep is over at the crossing. plane < 0.5 is the other half of the lateral-raise fix, 6 Sep 2026: a lateral raise puts the wrist level with the shoulder too, so without this the two exercises counted each other. This asks the upper arm to be more than 60 degrees away from straight out to the side, which a raise out in front always is and a raise out to the side never is.

tempo._note: measured window: topExit crossing -> bottomEnter crossing, not the full descent

cues.enter: Face the camera, arms hanging at your sides (10–20°).
cues.tooHigh: Raise the arms straight out in front to shoulder height — 90° at the shoulder.
cues.framing: I can't see your hips — step back.
